app_intro: The app sends your new SPAM matches and decks to the site automatically. It reads only the match files of the server api.crocodyle.fr and the deck lines of the game logs.
update_text: A new version of the app is available.
link_text: Link the app to your account on the site. You must log in with Steam on the site.
link_code: Enter this code on the site:
link_browser: The browser opens the link page. If it does not open, click the button below.
notice_unlinked: The app is unlinked. To delete the device on the site, revoke it on your account page.
notice_expired: The code expired. Link the app again.
notice_revoked: The site refused the token of the app. Link the app again.
folder_missing: The folder does not exist. Start SPAM one time, or set the folder by hand.
folder_none: No default folder is known for this system. Set the folder by hand.
autostart: Start the app when I log in to the computer
disclaimer: Unofficial fan app, not affiliated with Ticroco. SPAM content belongs to Ticroco.
